summary: Contain patch verification filesystem and network effects

delivery.outcome: Kernel-isolate baseline, staged and in-place Koru patch verification so candidate tests and descendants cannot write source/host paths or invoke network/host Unix socket effects; retain writable repository-owned scratch only. Preserve native-adoption classification and correct native fixtures and verification test doubles.
nonGoals: No editing, admission, lease, MCP or publication grant
No global host configuration or runtime activation
No changes to foreign active ticket446 or blocked ticket444

architecture.decision: Mandatory verification wrapper retains the injected shell-runner contract but runs its command through Linux bubblewrap plus a native-architecture libseccomp filter. All host mounts are read-only except exclusive repository-local scratch. Clear inherited environment; deny socket and namespace escape syscalls; fail closed if support is unavailable. Existing protected write/promotion boundaries are unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material implementation through protected publication; do not weaken sandbox requirements or issue authority from test receipts.
